names.note: Read out of saint.gr's line for 20 Αυγούστου, «Άγιος Οσγουΐνος», with the rank word left off. The page gives the Latin-script form beside it, «Ο Άγιος Οσγουΐνος (Oswin)», and uses «Άγιος Oswin» as a caption.

source.text: saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 20ης Αυγούστου — «Άγιος Οσγουΐνος»

attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 20 Αυγούστου εκάστου έτους», the same day as the listing, and it gives both the day and the year outright: «μαρτύρησε στο Gilling του Yorkshire της Αγγλίας, στις 20 Αυγούστου, 651 μ.Χ.» It prints his name in Latin script beside the Greek, «Ο Άγιος Οσγουΐνος (Oswin)», which is why the display name is the English form. The page names two saints the corpus already keeps and whose days it gives correctly — Aidan, «βλέπε 31 Αυγούστου», who baptised and educated him, and Bede, «βλέπε 27 Μαΐου», who is its authority for his character — and both are linked from the life. The page also links a «Σύναξη των εν Σκωτία διαλαμψάντων Αγίων», which is not an entry on this day's listing and is not drafted. No asterisk and no «Δεν είναι διασταυρωμένη» sentence on the life page. The page prints no hymn and no distich.
Not checked: the Ohrid Prologue on pravoslavno.rs for the corresponding Julian day (1 October 2026).

death.note: saint.gr: «μαρτύρησε στο Gilling του Yorkshire της Αγγλίας, στις 20 Αυγούστου, 651 μ.Χ.» The page gives no year of birth, only that his father king Osric was killed in 633 and that he reigned for about nine years.
